Let’s Help Build What’s Next.

At Innodata, our people are at the center of everything we do. From data engineers and AI specialists to project managers and analysts, our teams help the world’s leading companies build, train, and deploy advanced AI systems. 

We believe great ideas come from diverse perspectives and global collaboration.

With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia, you’ll work alongside experts solving some of the most complex data and AI challenges. 

Whether you’re launching your career or expanding your expertise, Innodata offers the opportunity to grow while making a real impact on the future of technology. 

The Values That Guide Our Work

Work at Global Scale

Collaborate with teams across North America, Europe, and Asia to help the world’s leading companies build and scale AI systems.

Solve Real AI Challenges

Our work sits at the intersection of data and artificial intelligence, helping enterprises train, deploy, and improve advanced AI technologies.

Think Critically

Great AI requires great judgment. We value curiosity, analytical thinking, and the ability to solve complex problems.

Move with Purpose

We work in a fast-moving industry where innovation happens quickly. Our teams adapt, learn, and continuously improve.

Collaborate Across Disciplines

From data scientists to linguists to engineers, our diverse teams bring together expertise from across industries and backgrounds.

Grow Your Expertise

We believe learning never stops. Innodata provides opportunities to build new skills and advance your career.

Job Scam Alert

Please be aware of recruitment scams involving individuals or organizations falsely claiming to represent employers. Innodata will never ask for payment, banking details, or sensitive personal information during the application process.

To learn more about how to recognize job scams, please visit the Federal Trade Commission’s guide:

consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a recruitment scam, please report it to:

verifyjoboffer@innodata.com

You may also report fraud to the FTC at:

ReportFraud.ftc.gov

Supporting Our People

We believe that supporting our people is key to delivering great work. While benefits may vary by region, we strive to provide programs that promote well-being, flexibility, and long-term career growth.

Competitive Compensation

We offer competitive pay designed to recognize your expertise and contributions.

Flexible Work Environment

Many of our teams operate in flexible or remote environments that support productivity and work-life balance.

Professional Growth

Opportunities to learn new skills, take on new challenges, and grow your career within a global organization.

Global Collaboration

Health & Wellness Benefits

Innodata (Nasdaq: INOD) is a global data engineering company. We believe that data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) are inextricably linked. Our mission is to enable the responsible advancement of artificial intelligence by providing the data, evaluation frameworks, and human expertise required to build AI systems that can be trusted at scale. We provide a range of transferable solutions, platforms, and services for Generative AI / AI builders and adopters. In every relationship, we honor our 36+ year legacy delivering the highest quality data and outstanding outcomes for our customers.
